objective: Test structurally distinct downside-protection and short-duration opportunity mechanisms independently, without tuning Generation 006 or constructing a switching strategy.

candidates.concept: Equity exposure may be safer when both long and intermediate trends agree, with defensive assets used otherwise.
candidates.fixed_rules: Hold SPY only above its 200-session mean while its 50-session mean exceeds its value 20 sessions earlier; otherwise hold the strongest positive 63-session return among BIL, IEF, and GLD, or SHY.

candidates.concept: A material drawdown that remains below a short trend may warrant temporary capital preservation.
candidates.fixed_rules: Hold SHY when SPY is at least eight percent below its trailing 63-session high and below its 20-session mean; otherwise hold SPY.

candidates.concept: Rapid volatility expansion combined with negative equity momentum may identify a distinct risk-off episode.
candidates.fixed_rules: When SPY 20-session volatility is at least 1.5 times 60-session volatility and its 20-session return is negative, hold the strongest positive 20-session defensive asset among BIL, IEF, and GLD, or SHY; otherwise hold SPY.

candidates.concept: A sharp short pullback inside a persistent sector uptrend may create a short-duration rebound opportunity.
candidates.fixed_rules: Select the deepest sector three-session decline of at least three percent that reverses upward, retains positive 63-session momentum and a positive 200-session trend, and remains above its 50-session mean; otherwise hold SHY.

candidates.concept: A downside range break that is quickly reclaimed inside a long-term uptrend may represent seller exhaustion.
candidates.fixed_rules: Hold SPY after a close below the prior 20-session closing low within four sessions is reclaimed with an upward close while the 200-session trend remains positive; otherwise hold SHY.

candidates.concept: Fresh strength in a defensive asset during a negative equity trend may offer positive participation rather than only cash preservation.
candidates.fixed_rules: When SPY is below its 200-session mean, hold the strongest positive 63-session defensive asset making a new 63-session closing high among BIL, IEF, and GLD; otherwise hold SHY.
